features: Sharper Action, Brighter Details - Osmo Nano's 1/1.3′′ sensor captures more light for crisp, vivid shots. Ideal as a 4K POV camera or vlogging camera, even in low light or fast-action scenes.
Ultra-Wide 4K Clarity - Record every moment in 4K/60fps with a 143° ultra-wide view. Ideal as a small action camera or for immersive Pet POV adventures and vlogging.
Effortless Portability & Versatility - The lightweight, magnetic Osmo Nano is the ideal pocket camera for easy carrying. Use it as a portable camera for on-the-go filming and enjoy hands-free POVs.
Vivid Cinematic Colors - Osmo Nano delivers vibrant, lifelike footage with 10-bit and D-Log M color performance, making it an ideal vlogging or body cam for creative edits and pro results.
200-Min Extended Battery Life & Fast Charging - Up to 200 minutes of battery [2] and quick charging keep your 4K camera ready for vlogs, Pet POV walks, and every adventure.
128GB Built‐In Storage & Expandable Memory – Start recording right out of the box with 128GB of built-in storage. Plus, expand with a microSD card for more great moments.

Crystal-Clear Audio, Instantly - Osmo Nano supports direct connection to two microphones [4], delivering original, high-quality sound for your vlogs. Enjoy immersive audio and pro-level results anywhere.
Adventure-Ready Waterproofing - The Camera is waterproof up to 10m [5] and offers IPX4 splash resistance with the Vision Dock. Take on underwater or outdoor adventures confidently with Osmo Nano.

Heating during high-res recording is normal due to the compact design. Built-in overheat protection automatically stops recording to ensure hardware safety. For longer sessions, we recommend enabling Endurance Mode.

Due to platform compatibility issues, the DJI Mimo app has been removed from Google Play. For a better product experience, please visit the official DJI website to download the latest version of DJI Mimo.
